# Permissions

Roles inherit: `owner` ⊇ `adult` ⊇ `child` (AUTHZ-3). See [authorization.md](../platform/authorization.md).

## Permissions by role

| Permission | Description | owner | adult | child |
|---|---|:-:|:-:|:-:|
| `platform.audit.read` | Read the household's audit log | ✓ | — | — |
| `platform.household.manage` | Rename the household, change its time zone | ✓ | — | — |
| `platform.household.read` | See the household and its members | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
